glossary._note: Fixed terms every German page must use. Brand 'uvaindex.org' and the abbreviations UVA, UVB, UVC, UV, PA, nm, W/m² stay as they are. SPF is 'Lichtschutzfaktor (LSF)' on first use, then 'LSF'.

glossary.tone: Use 'du'. Clear, friendly German for a general audience. Decimal comma in prose (0,5). Compound nouns with hyphens for abbreviations (UVA-Strahlung, UV-Index).
